SELECT C.CI_ID AS ciId, C.SYS_ID AS sysId, S.SYS_NM AS sysNm, C.CI_NM AS ciNm, C.CI_TYPE AS ciType, TC.CODE_NM AS ciTypeNm, C.VER AS ver, C.CI_STATUS AS ciStatus, SC.CODE_NM AS ciStatusNm, C.OWNER_ID AS ownerId FROM OPS_CI C LEFT JOIN OPS_SYSTEM S ON C.SYS_ID = S.SYS_ID LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE TC ON TC.CODE_GRP = 'CI_TYPE' AND TC.CODE_ID = C.CI_TYPE LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE SC ON SC.CODE_GRP = 'CI_STATUS' AND SC.CODE_ID = C.CI_STATUS WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY C.CI_ID DESC OFFSET #{firstIndex} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{recordCountPerPage} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OPS_CI C WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT C.CI_ID AS ciId, C.SYS_ID AS sysId, S.SYS_NM AS sysNm, C.CI_NM AS ciNm, C.CI_TYPE AS ciType, TC.CODE_NM AS ciTypeNm, C.VER AS ver, C.CI_STATUS AS ciStatus, SC.CODE_NM AS ciStatusNm, C.LOCATION AS location, C.OWNER_ID AS ownerId, C.CI_DESC AS ciDesc, TO_CHAR(C.REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS regDt FROM OPS_CI C LEFT JOIN OPS_SYSTEM S ON C.SYS_ID = S.SYS_ID LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE TC ON TC.CODE_GRP = 'CI_TYPE' AND TC.CODE_ID = C.CI_TYPE LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE SC ON SC.CODE_GRP = 'CI_STATUS' AND SC.CODE_ID = C.CI_STATUS WHERE C.CI_ID = #{ciId}

SELECT H.HIS_ID AS hisId, H.CI_ID AS ciId, H.CHG_TYPE AS chgType, GC.CODE_NM AS chgTypeNm, H.VER AS ver, H.CONTENT AS content, H.PROC_ID AS procId, TO_CHAR(H.PROC_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS procDt FROM OPS_CI_HIS H LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE GC ON GC.CODE_GRP = 'CI_CHG_TYPE' AND GC.CODE_ID = H.CHG_TYPE WHERE H.CI_ID = #{ciId} ORDER BY H.HIS_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OPS_CI (SYS_ID, CI_NM, CI_TYPE, VER, CI_STATUS, LOCATION, OWNER_ID, CI_DESC, REG_DT) VALUES (#{sysId}, #{ciNm}, #{ciType}, #{ver}, #{ciStatus}, #{location}, #{ownerId}, #{ciDesc}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE OPS_CI SET SYS_ID = #{sysId}, CI_NM = #{ciNm}, CI_TYPE = #{ciType}, VER = #{ver}, LOCATION = #{location}, OWNER_ID = #{ownerId}, CI_DESC = #{ciDesc} WHERE CI_ID = #{ciId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OPS_CI_HIS (CI_ID, CHG_TYPE, VER, CONTENT, PROC_ID, PROC_DT) VALUES (#{ciId}, #{chgType}, #{ver}, #{content}, #{procId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
